metrics_preregistered.early_bust: ADP<=36: bust = pos finish > 2x pos-ADP-rank AND >15; gap = bust% of low-safety half minus high-safety half
metrics_preregistered.late_hit: ADP 84-240: hit = QB/TE top-12, RB/WR top-24; gap = hit% of high-ceiling half minus low-ceiling half
metrics_preregistered.ordering: within-position Spearman of sc vs final pos finish, and of ADP vs finish (the market yardstick)
